result.instructions: Tools for Recurpay, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which subscriptions are halted because a renewal payment failed?"; "Show me the active subscriptions on my monthly plan and when they bill next."; "Find the subscriber with the email jane@example.com and list her subscriptions and orders.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Recurpay data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run recurpay_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run recurpay_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run recurpay_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. recurpay_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: recurpay_get_access_scopes
tools.description: Show the API scopes of the custom app whose token is connected (read-/write- subscriptions, customers, orders, plans, payments, webhooks). Use it when a tool answers 403.

tools.name: recurpay_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List the store's subscriptions (status active/paused/halted/cancelled/draft, subscriber, plan policies, line items, next_billing_at). Filter by status, plan, subscriber email and dates. Use status=halted to find subscriptions whose renewal payment failed. Page with next_page.

plan_id.description: Only subscriptions of this plan (id from recurpay_list_plans).

email.description: Only subscriptions of the subscriber with this email.

created_at_min.description: Only subscriptions created on or after this date.

created_at_max.description: Only subscriptions created on or before this date.

updated_at_min.description: Only subscriptions updated on or after this date.

updated_at_max.description: Only subscriptions updated on or before this date.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: recurpay_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription with its subscriber, addresses, line items, discount codes, billing/delivery policy, payment method and billing dates.

tools.name: recurpay_list_subscribers
tools.description: List the store's subscribers (customers with at least one subscription): name, email, phone, addresses, total spent. Filter by name, email and dates. Page with next_page.

first_name.description: Only subscribers with this first name.

last_name.description: Only subscribers with this last name.

email.description: Only the subscriber with this email.

created_at_min.description: Only subscribers created on or after this date.

created_at_max.description: Only subscribers created on or before this date.

updated_at_min.description: Only subscribers updated on or after this date.

updated_at_max.description: Only subscribers updated on or before this date.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: recurpay_get_subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber (customer) with contact data, addresses and total spent.

tools.name: recurpay_list_orders
tools.description: List the orders generated by subscriptions (name, subscriber, status, totals). Filter by order name, subscriber email, subscription and dates. Page with next_page.

name.description: Only orders with this name (the store's order number).

email.description: Only orders of the subscriber with this email.

created_at_min.description: Only orders created on or after this date.

created_at_max.description: Only orders created on or before this date.

updated_at_min.description: Only orders updated on or after this date.

updated_at_max.description: Only orders updated on or before this date.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: recurpay_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its subscriber and line items.

tools.name: recurpay_list_order_subscriptions
tools.description: List the subscriptions that belong to one order.

created_at_min.description: Only subscriptions created on or after this date.

created_at_max.description: Only subscriptions created on or before this date.

updated_at_min.description: Only subscriptions updated on or after this date.

updated_at_max.description: Only subscriptions updated on or before this date.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: recurpay_list_plans
tools.description: List the subscription plans (selling plan groups) with their delivery/billing policies and discounts. Filter by plan title, product title/handle and dates. Page with next_page.

product_title.description: Only plans attached to a product with this title.

product_handle.description: Only plans attached to a product with this handle.

created_at_min.description: Only plans created on or after this date.

created_at_max.description: Only plans created on or before this date.

updated_at_min.description: Only plans updated on or after this date.

updated_at_max.description: Only plans updated on or before this date.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: recurpay_get_plan
tools.description: Get one plan with its selling plans (delivery policy, billing policy, anchors, discounts).

tools.name: recurpay_list_plan_products
tools.description: List the products attached to one plan, with the variants excluded from it.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: recurpay_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions of the store (topic, address, status). Needs the read-webhooks scope.

created_at_min.description: Only webhooks created at or after this date.

created_at_max.description: Only webhooks created at or before this date.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: recurpay_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.description: WRITE: cancel one subscriber's subscription in Recurpay (status becomes cancelled; billing and deliveries stop). This is the merchant's action on a customer's subscription, not the cancellation of this MCP server's own plan. Only the merchant can re-activate it. Ask the user to confirm the subscription first.

cancelled_reason.description: Reason shown on the subscription, e.g. 'Customer asked to cancel'.

tools.name: recurpay_skip_next_billing
tools.description: WRITE: skip the subscription's next billing/delivery cycle (the next order is not generated). Ask the user to confirm the subscription first.

tools.name: recurpay_renew_subscription
tools.description: WRITE, MAY CHARGE THE CUSTOMER: renew the subscription now. Recurpay runs the billing cycle immediately, which can charge the subscriber's saved payment method and create an order. Use it e.g. to retry a halted subscription. Only call it when the user explicitly asks for it and set confirm=true. Repeated calls may repeat the charge or notification.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approved this action and its customer/charge effects.

tools.name: recurpay_send_payment_link
tools.description: WRITE, CONTACTS THE CUSTOMER: generate a payment link for the subscription (renewal payment or payment-method update); Recurpay notifies the subscriber with it. Use it for halted subscriptions. Only call it when the user explicitly asks for it and set confirm=true. Repeated calls may repeat the charge or notification.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approved this action and its customer/charge effects.

annotations.title: Send a payment link to the subscriber

tools.name: recurpay_update_subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: change a subscriber's contact data (email, first name, last name, phone). Only the fields you pass are sent. Ask the user to confirm the new values.

phone.description: New phone number in international format, e.g. +12025550151.

tools.name: recurpay_update_subscription_coupon
tools.description: WRITE: add or remove a discount code (coupon) on one subscription; it changes what the subscriber pays on the next billings. Ask the user to confirm.

action.description: add = apply the code, remove = take it off.

code.description: The discount code title, e.g. TEST20.

annotations.title: Add or remove a subscription coupon
